<subject>Re: Mount Horizon development agreement</subject>
<body>
Jon,

By the time the capital expenses noted in #2 are booked, the project should be under the control of Tasman Ridge Logistics Pty Ltd (or its designated successor entity) as construction will be nearly finished. The costs in #3 are expected to be part of Phase 2 Tasman Ridge Logistics expenses, as this falls within the construction window, but could possibly precede it slightly.

Whitney, I omitted Amy since she’s away this week, but I reviewed this contract before her leave.

Adam
